tags.name: letter

attributes.page-width-mm: Positive custom paper width; requires page-height-mm
attributes.page-height-mm: Positive custom paper height; requires page-width-mm
attributes.margins-mm: Finite uniform physical page margin, in mm
attributes.zone-id: Java ZoneId name; affects temporal formatting

tags.defaults: A4 portrait; 20 mm margins; 25 mm header; 15 mm footer; en-GB, LONG dates, UTC; no selected currency.
tags.description: Use letter markup without html/head/body wrappers. Root typography is inherited by content; use Java for independent per-side margins. Custom paper dimensions are a pair. Positive-size paper must accommodate margins/zones.

tags.name: main
tags.defaults: One required region; body blocks keep source order.
tags.description: Only the body flow permits explicit page-break blocks. A selected template must contain renderable body content.

tags.name: header
tags.context: Direct child of letter; unique per page selector

attributes.align: left, center or right; controls box placement and initial text alignment
attributes.x-mm: Exact x relative to inner page; requires all four bounds
attributes.y-mm: Exact y relative to inner page; requires all four bounds

tags.defaults: All pages; automatic left-aligned placement; height derives from header-height-mm.
tags.description: Exact placement requires x-mm, y-mm, width-mm and height-mm together. Text alignment can be overridden on child blocks. Put paragraph margins on child p/div blocks. FIRST/FOLLOWING variants override ALL on matching pages.

tags.name: footer
tags.context: Direct child of letter; unique per page selector
tags.defaults: All pages; fitting height uses footer-height-mm.
tags.description: Supported rich blocks and images; no page breaks. Reserve sufficient height on letter. Put text spacing on child blocks.

tags.name: logo
tags.defaults: Image fitting box 45 × 20 mm.
tags.description: Exactly one img child. Apply dimensions/styles to img, not to the logo wrapper. Named image assets only.

tags.name: signature

attributes.height-mm: Finite positive signature reservation, in mm

tags.defaults: flow; 20 mm.
tags.description: Styled text/images/blocks; no page breaks. bottom-last places the signature on the final generated letter page above the footer. This is a visible signature, not cryptographic signing.

tags.name: watermark

attributes.rotation: Finite rotation in degrees, about page center

tags.defaults: All pages; opacity 0.12; text 45° / image 0°; image fitting box 80 × 40 mm.
tags.description: Either plain text or exactly one img child. Text uses independent watermark font/color/size defaults and permits only regular undecorated text. No named style. Image styles belong on img. Standard PDF profile only; does not reserve body space.

tags.name: sender
tags.defaults: Optional semantic regions; role defaults/theme apply.
tags.description: Rich block content. Fluent/HTML semantic parts assemble in conventional letter order rather than arbitrary root tag order. Each role is unique.

tags.name: recipient
tags.defaults: Optional semantic regions; role defaults/theme apply.
tags.description: Rich block content. Fluent/HTML semantic parts assemble in conventional letter order rather than arbitrary root tag order. Each role is unique.

tags.name: subject
tags.defaults: Optional semantic regions; role defaults/theme apply.
tags.description: Rich block content. Fluent/HTML semantic parts assemble in conventional letter order rather than arbitrary root tag order. Each role is unique.

tags.name: salutation
tags.defaults: Optional semantic regions; role defaults/theme apply.
tags.description: Rich block content. Fluent/HTML semantic parts assemble in conventional letter order rather than arbitrary root tag order. Each role is unique.

tags.name: closing
tags.defaults: Optional semantic regions; role defaults/theme apply.
tags.description: Rich block content. Fluent/HTML semantic parts assemble in conventional letter order rather than arbitrary root tag order. Each role is unique.

tags.name: date
tags.defaults: Final document locale/date pattern formats a value attribute.
tags.description: Choose value with no child content, or authored rich date content without value. Supports semantic DATE theme styling.

tags.name: reference
tags.defaults: Semantic REFERENCE role.
tags.description: Authored rich content follows the configured label.

tags.name: p
tags.context: Inside a region, rich cell, group or supported container
tags.defaults: Inherited body typography; ordinary paragraph flow.
tags.description: Inline text and formatting. Source whitespace is normalized by markup parsing; use br for explicit lines. Images are separate blocks.

tags.name: h1
tags.defaults: Bold; semantic sizes h1=18, h2=16, h3=14, h4=12, h5=11, h6=10 pt, below named/explicit overrides; keep with next.
tags.description: Inline formatted heading text. Current tagged-PDF model emits H1 for every heading level; HTML level does not establish a complete PDF heading hierarchy.

tags.defaults: Bold; semantic sizes h1=18, h2=16, h3=14, h4=12, h5=11, h6=10 pt, below named/explicit overrides; keep with next.

tags.description: Inline formatted heading text. Current tagged-PDF model emits H1 for every heading level; HTML level does not establish a complete PDF heading hierarchy.

tags.name: div
tags.defaults: Text-only div becomes a text block; block children make an inherited style scope.
tags.description: Style scopes preserve named-style inheritance. Mixing bare text with child block elements is rejected; wrap prose in p when grouping blocks.

tags.name: group
tags.defaults: Soft keep-together by default; style can choose auto/prefer/always.
tags.description: Groups supported blocks. An impossible strict keep can fail. Page breaks are only allowed where the enclosing body context permits them.

tags.name: span
tags.context: Inline text within paragraphs, headings and list/cell text
tags.defaults: span inherits; strong/b set bold; em/i set italic; u sets underline.
tags.description: Use style/style-name for supported typography. Explicit false/normal values can override inherited emphasis. Styles must name registered or standard font faces.

tags.name: strong
tags.context: Inline text within paragraphs, headings and list/cell text
tags.defaults: span inherits; strong/b set bold; em/i set italic; u sets underline.
tags.description: Use style/style-name for supported typography. Explicit false/normal values can override inherited emphasis. Styles must name registered or standard font faces.

tags.name: b
tags.context: Inline text within paragraphs, headings and list/cell text
tags.defaults: span inherits; strong/b set bold; em/i set italic; u sets underline.
tags.description: Use style/style-name for supported typography. Explicit false/normal values can override inherited emphasis. Styles must name registered or standard font faces.

tags.name: em
tags.context: Inline text within paragraphs, headings and list/cell text
tags.defaults: span inherits; strong/b set bold; em/i set italic; u sets underline.
tags.description: Use style/style-name for supported typography. Explicit false/normal values can override inherited emphasis. Styles must name registered or standard font faces.

tags.name: i
tags.context: Inline text within paragraphs, headings and list/cell text
tags.defaults: span inherits; strong/b set bold; em/i set italic; u sets underline.
tags.description: Use style/style-name for supported typography. Explicit false/normal values can override inherited emphasis. Styles must name registered or standard font faces.

tags.name: u
tags.context: Inline text within paragraphs, headings and list/cell text
tags.defaults: span inherits; strong/b set bold; em/i set italic; u sets underline.
tags.description: Use style/style-name for supported typography. Explicit false/normal values can override inherited emphasis. Styles must name registered or standard font faces.

tags.name: a

attributes.href: Required HTTP, HTTPS or mailto destination
attributes.title: Optional descriptive title

tags.defaults: Inherited appearance.
tags.description: Links remain native PDF links. Unsupported URI schemes are rejected. Link text may use supported inline formatting.

tags.name: br
tags.defaults: Explicit line change within the current text block.
tags.description: Void HTML element; no children. Use another p for a new paragraph.

tags.name: page-number
tags.defaults: Dynamic current/total generated-letter page number.
tags.description: Empty elements with paired closing tags. Counts exclude appended attachment pages. They do not accept text children.

tags.name: page-count
tags.defaults: Dynamic current/total generated-letter page number.
tags.description: Empty elements with paired closing tags. Counts exclude appended attachment pages. They do not accept text children.

tags.name: page-break
tags.defaults: Starts a new body page.
tags.description: Empty, paired closing tag; no attributes including style/style-name. Not allowed inside tables, fixed regions, signatures, canvases or columns.

tags.name: img
tags.context: Standalone block, supported region/rich cell, logo or image watermark

attributes.src: Required asset:name reference to supplied bytes
attributes.width: Positive mm/pt/px/% length; unitless means px at 96 dpi
attributes.height: Positive mm/pt/px/% length; unitless means px at 96 dpi
attributes.alt: Image description used in tagged output

tags.defaults: Body fitting box up to 60 × 40 mm; region-specific defaults elsewhere; aspect ratio preserved.
tags.description: PNG/JPEG/restricted static SVG. CSS dimensions override attributes. Percentages use available region dimensions. Width alone permits natural fitted height. No URL/file fetch, inline text images or image background-color.

tags.name: ul
tags.defaults: Unordered bullets / ordered numbering; each nested list has independent numbering/indentation.
tags.description: Direct li children with inline text and optional nested lists. Arbitrary paragraph/image/table blocks inside li are unsupported.

tags.name: ol
tags.defaults: Unordered bullets / ordered numbering; each nested list has independent numbering/indentation.
tags.description: Direct li children with inline text and optional nested lists. Arbitrary paragraph/image/table blocks inside li are unsupported.

tags.name: li
tags.context: Direct child of ul or ol
tags.defaults: Inline formatted item text.
tags.description: Place text before child ul/ol lists; text after a child list is rejected.

tags.name: table

attributes.column-weights: Comma-separated positive finite relative column weights

tags.defaults: Equal weights; ordinary row keeps prefer keeping a row together; optional theme table appearance.
tags.description: One optional repeating thead row plus body rows. Define tbody for grouped rows. Spans must occupy a valid grid. No nested tables/page breaks, including through components.

tags.name: thead
tags.defaults: Optional repeating header section.
tags.description: Exactly one logical tr header row; th/td cells may span columns. Header and body span grids are independent. Keep rules intended for body rows are rejected in headers. The keep-together attribute is rejected on thead.

tags.name: tbody

attributes.keep-together: auto, prefer or always; applies to this body row group

tags.defaults: Body row group; optional inherited cell/text appearance.
tags.description: Multiple groups can define explicit row grouping. Spans must stay within their legal grid/group constraints.

tags.name: tr
tags.context: Direct child of thead/tbody or supported table structure

attributes.row-keep: auto, prefer or always; body rows only
attributes.keep-with-next: auto, prefer or always; body rows only

tags.defaults: Inherits table row policy.
tags.description: Direct th/td cells only. Template data-each/data-as/data-if may select or repeat real rows. Header row keep overrides are rejected.

tags.name: th
tags.defaults: 1 × 1; th has bold semantic default below named/explicit overrides.
tags.description: Either inline text or supported rich blocks. Borders/padding/background/vertical alignment inherit by field. Text mixed with child block elements is rejected.

tags.name: td
tags.defaults: 1 × 1; th has bold semantic default below named/explicit overrides.
tags.description: Either inline text or supported rich blocks. Borders/padding/background/vertical alignment inherit by field. Text mixed with child block elements is rejected.

tags.name: canvas

attributes.width-mm: Optional finite positive width; defaults to available region width

tags.defaults: Coordinates start at the canvas upper-left corner within body flow.
tags.description: Bounded indivisible flow unit containing positioned box children. Boxes must fit; overlaps are intentional in list paint order. No automatic splitting, browser absolute positioning or page breaks.
tags.example: Example address

tags.name: columns
tags.defaults: 0 mm gap; independent columns.
tags.description: Column children split the available width by weight and can flow across pages. No automatic text threading/balancing; no explicit page breaks inside columns.

tags.name: column
tags.defaults: Weight 1.
tags.description: Independent supported block content and local style. A wider weight does not cause text to flow from another column.

tags.name: box
tags.context: Flowing block, or positioned direct child of canvas

attributes.id: Canvas box only: Required unique nonblank stable identifier
attributes.x-mm: Canvas box: finite nonnegative x; defaults to 0
attributes.y-mm: Canvas box: finite nonnegative y; defaults to 0
attributes.width-mm: Canvas box only: Required finite positive item width
attributes.height-mm: Canvas box only: Required finite positive item height

tags.defaults: Ordinary flowing content with optional decoration.
tags.description: Supports padding, background-color, border and per-edge borders alongside inherited typography. No general browser box model. Inside canvas, box instead declares a bounded positioned rectangle with a unique id, explicit width/height and optional x/y. Its rich content must fit; no page breaks. Decoration CSS applies to flowing box, not the positioned canvas wrapper.

tags.name: component

attributes.ref: Required name registered through components(...) or the shared model

tags.defaults: Expands document-local reusable blocks before validation.
tags.description: Empty element with a paired closing tag. Unknown references and reference cycles fail. Context rules still apply to expanded content.

tags.name: param
tags.context: Inline template content; template mode only
tags.defaults: text formatting unless selected; final template locale applies.
tags.description: Void HTML tag, no closing tag, children or style/style-name. Wrap with span/strong for styling. Substitution creates literal text, never markup. Supported input type must match the format.

tags.name: if

attributes.flag: Required map path to an actual Boolean

tags.defaults: Selects true branch or direct else branch; no expressions/truthiness.
tags.description: Only flag is permitted. Use data-if on real table rows/cells. Inactive branches do not require their values/assets.

tags.name: else
tags.defaults: Selected when flag is false.
tags.description: No attributes, including style/style-name. Must be unique and in the supported final branch position.

css.name: font-family
css.values: One exact standard or registered family name; quoted single family allowed
css.notes: No comma-separated fallback list; configure fallback families in DocumentSettings.

css.name: font-size
css.values: Positive finite pt/mm/px length; nonzero unitless values are rejected
css.default: 11 pt body; typed Heading 14 pt; HTML headings have level-specific defaults

css.name: color
css.values: #RGB, #RRGGBB, black, white, gray, grey, red, green, blue, navy, teal

css.name: font-weight
css.notes: Required font face must be registered or standard; no synthesis.

css.name: text-align
css.notes: Independent from header rectangle placement; header align attribute excludes justify.

css.name: margin-top
css.notes: Apply to p/div or individual blocks, not region wrappers.

css.name: keep-together
css.default: Ordinary block policy; group uses a soft keep
css.notes: Always can fail when content cannot fit.

css.name: keep-with-next
css.default: Ordinary block policy; headings keep with next

css.name: width
css.notes: CSS overrides width attribute; not for tables or canvas.

css.name: padding
css.values: One, two or four nonnegative lengths (mm/pt/px; zero unitless)
css.notes: Two values mean vertical/horizontal; four mean top/right/bottom/left; three-value form unsupported.

css.name: border
css.values: none or width style color, e.g. 0.5pt solid #222222
css.notes: Supported styles: solid, dashed, dotted; use full declaration, no browser shorthand inference.

css.name: border-top
css.notes: Per-edge overrides are not table-cell CSS properties.

css.name: border-right
css.notes: Per-edge overrides are not table-cell CSS properties.

css.name: border-bottom
css.notes: Per-edge overrides are not table-cell CSS properties.

css.name: border-left
css.notes: Per-edge overrides are not table-cell CSS properties.

commonAttributes.style: Supported inline CSS only; no external selectors.
commonAttributes.style-name: A named style registered in the document theme; explicit local values win.
commonAttributes.data-if: Template-only Boolean map path on an ordinary parsed element; removed before markup validation.
commonAttributes.data-each: Template-only List map path on tr or supported block/list/item/image/component elements; clones trusted nodes.
commonAttributes.data-as: Required simple alias with data-each; letters/underscore then letters/digits/underscore.
